unit: One canonical root per training map and candidate physical seat at most. Keep every map/seat denominator including zero qualifying roots. These 24 registered training results are already known in aggregate. The selection stage must never consult any outcome or later state, elapsed performance, future menu support, player names or weights.

clock.priority: First try band (seed-621758460+seat) % 3. Then the next two bands cyclically. Within the chosen band use the earliest eligible pre-action step across the two draws; simultaneous ties favor draw_a for even seed+seat or draw_b for odd.

observable_eligibility.both: Official episode still active and both players have at least one living worker on the public board.
observable_eligibility.cash_gap: Own publicly visible bank cash minus opponent cash; absolute gap <= 600.
observable_eligibility.inventory_gap: Own sum of publicly visible collector loads minus opponent collector loads; absolute value of cash_gap + 0.5 * inventory_gap <= 600. Half weight is an a priori discount for risky cargo, not an estimated delivery probability.
observable_eligibility.strata: Describe adjusted gap < -150 as behind, >150 as ahead, otherwise level; no quota by score stratum. Show both full-denominator histograms. Stratification by time is fixed before reading these frames.

physical_dedup: Canonical official board digest includes opening physical map, step, complete rule-state observation (including hidden map for archive identity only), both players and trees; excludes measured wall clocks and derived fog to prevent double-counting identical physical states. The policy cannot use this digest. For a physical duplicate across two tickets assign to the numerically first (seed,seat); continue to the next qualifying root for later ticket. For draws at identical root prefer scheduled tie direction.
two_pass: Materialize and hash roots.json before reading follow-up outcomes/actions. Then replay the recorded suffix, audit every ticket's scheduled 851c supported binary and actual draw from root inclusive and strictly after root, and report both banks, final official scores, WDL, realized cash-gap change, trees, cargo, and control caveats. Preserve every selected root even if no later supported menu or historical win.
restore: Bind each root to the archived exact GitHub ZIP/SHA, registration/rule and full issued command-tape hashes, byte-for-byte prefix hash and last-action boundary, seat-specific public observation digests and remaining clock banks. Replaying original official environment from the map seed up to but excluding the root action must reproduce both public hashes and complete board-state digest. Replay provides both seat observation histories and past physical actions. Original private RNG and process search caches are not captured. A useable future training fork needs an explicit tested controller-history contract before claiming original suffix outcomes.
use: Training maps only. Historical continuation describes what occurred. No strength inference, no imputation of alternative outcomes, no games or branches run by this selection.
